data.name: Mohan
data.gender_notes: Mohan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root muh, 'to be bewildered, to charm' — mohana, 'charming'. Its root is Sanskrit muh (मुह्). An epithet of Krishna (Mohan). Mohan is a Sanskrit name meaning “Charming; bewitching; delightful”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mohan expresses “Charming; bewitching; delightful”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root muh, 'to be bewildered, to charm' — mohana, 'charming'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohan total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
